content.text:
Confirmed: `system.properties` is a build-time resource file containing only `vendor`, `product-version`, `product-build`, `git-commit`, etc. — it never contains `exist.home`, which is a JVM system property set at runtime (e.g., via `-Dexist.home=...`). So any call to `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", ...)` is guaranteed to always fall back to the default `"unknown"`, regardless of the actual eXist home directory.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: c342cbc05e44f776f0055b8182abbf4550a6c459

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the full history of `src/org/exist/jetty/JettyStart.java` with `git log -p --follow`. The fix commit changes the "eXist Home" log line from reading `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")` back to `System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`. I searched the full file history for every occurrence of "exist.home"/"eXist Home" to find where this `SystemProperties`-based lookup for `exist.home` was first introduced.

**(2) Root cause commit:** Commit `c342cbc05e44f776f0055b8182abbf4550a6c459` (Adam Retter, 2011-04-19) refactored `JettyStart` to replace ad-hoc loading of a `Properties` object from `org/exist/system.properties` with the new `SystemProperties` helper class, for `product-version`, `product-build`, and `svn-revision`. In that same refactor, the "eXist Home" line was *also* switched from `System.getProperty("exist.home")` to `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")` — but `exist.home` is not one of the build-time properties baked into `system.properties`; it's a runtime JVM system property. This made the "eXist Home" log line always print `"unknown"` instead of the actual home directory.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** `src/org/exist/system.properties` (the resource `SystemProperties` loads) only contains `vendor`, `vendor-url`, `product-name`, `product-version`, `product-semver`, `product-build`, `git-commit` — there is no `exist.home` key and never was one in this file's history. `SystemProperties.getSystemProperty` does a plain `Properties.getProperty(name, defaultValue)` lookup against that static file, with no fallback to `System.getProperty`. This mismatch persisted unnoticed from 2011 until the 2016 fix commit `1856857af` reverted the "eXist Home" line to use `System.getProperty("exist.home", ...)` directly, leaving the other three properties (which are legitimately build-time) still using `SystemProperties`.

I'm confident in this identification — the mechanism is clear and directly matches the fix's intent, with no ambiguity about which line/commit caused it.
